name: Integer Overflow and Underflow
description: Arithmetic operations can overflow or underflow in Solidity <0.8.0

detectors.name: Unchecked Arithmetic (Post-0.8.0)
detectors.description: Using unchecked block bypasses Solidity 0.8.0 overflow protection

detectors.name: No SafeMath (Pre-0.8.0)
detectors.description: Solidity <0.8.0 without SafeMath or overflow checks

detectors.name: Unsafe Type Casting
detectors.description: Downcasting can cause overflow (e.g., uint256 to uint128)

detectors.name: Multiplication Before Division
detectors.description: May cause precision loss or overflow in intermediate result

remediation: Use Solidity >=0.8.0 which has built-in overflow protection, use SafeMath for <0.8.0, carefully review unchecked blocks, use OpenZeppelin's Math library for precise calculations
